purpose: Canonical outcome ownership map for consolidating the full web platform into one governed operating system.

outcomes.name: Operational Health
outcomes.mission: Own platform health, freshness, closure state, retry posture, trust pressure, and run integrity from one canonical lane.
consolidate_now: legacy health and alert viewpoints that duplicate Watchtower outcomes
next_moves: Move remaining operational ownership out of Portfolio_Monitoring into Watchtower and canonical health APIs.
Keep pilot monitoring specialized, but make it consume canonical health and trust signals instead of parallel logic.

outcomes.name: Portfolio Briefing
outcomes.canonical_owner: PIB / POP Brief family through The Pond
outcomes.mission: Provide the canonical portfolio and property briefing family without forking PIB truth or allowing duplicate briefing systems.
consolidate_now: brief-family sprawl across PIB, POP Brief, Spotlight, and imported reporting conventions
parallel report entry points that target the same executive understanding outcome
next_moves: Define the formal report-family architecture: PIB, POP Brief, Spotlight, specialty reports, and when each is canonical.
Keep the locked PIB generator protected and orchestrate around it from the Pond.

outcomes.name: Portfolio Insight and Navigation
outcomes.mission: Own how operators and stakeholders move through portfolio insight, reports, and tools inside one cohesive product surface.
consolidate_now: Portfolio_Dashboard overlap with Dock and modern analysis surfaces
multiple UI entry layers for similar portfolio-insight outcomes
next_moves: Absorb useful Portfolio_Dashboard patterns into Dock, Analysis, or dedicated Pond views.
Stop treating Portfolio_Dashboard as a parallel default navigation surface.

outcomes.name: Content Operations
outcomes.canonical_owner: Intelligence Office + Site Content Creator + VACS
outcomes.mission: Connect truth, interpretation, structure, and execution into one governed content system rather than parallel planning and generation efforts.
consolidate_now: content-planning and generation efforts that bypass the Intelligence Office / Site Content / VACS spine
next_moves: Finish Site Content as a settled governed execution lane.
Keep VACS API-first but aligned to the same truth and directive stack.

outcomes.name: Validation and Experience
outcomes.mission: Own staging-first validation, experiential evidence, and mixed human-and-machine execution without scattering validation truth across ad hoc checks.
consolidate_now: ad hoc screenshot/manual validation flows that should route through EVS
next_moves: Keep execution specialized while using the Pond workspace as the canonical operator layer.
Decide whether workflow dispatch remains external or becomes a governed API action.

outcomes.name: Data Truth and Collection
outcomes.mission: Own normalized facts, lineage, freshness, and shared APIs for the full web platform.
consolidate_now: script-only truth assumptions outside the canonical Data Collection path
next_moves: Continue moving overlapping legacy collection ownership into the canonical Data Collection and app API stack.
Keep all report and product lanes consuming this shared truth rather than private data paths.

enterprise_rules: No new parallel dashboards for an existing outcome.
No new script-only canonical system when a Pond or API contract already exists.
No private canonical truth outside the Data Pond.
Keeper plus Cloudflare Zero Trust plus app roles is the default security posture.
Nested repos must be treated as explicit boundary objects, not accidental homes for net-new canonical ownership.

Still overlaps navigation and insight outcomes that should be represented in the main app
